from.name: Settlement Payment Authorization
from.description: A claimant authorizes the settlement payment to their counsel's client trust account; counsel confirms the account.

body.p: Matter: {{matter}}. Under the settlement agreement dated {{settlement_date}}, Fontara, Inc. will pay ${{amount}} (the "Settlement Payment").
I, the claimant, authorize Fontara, Inc. to pay the Settlement Payment into my counsel's client trust account below, and I agree that payment there discharges Fontara's payment obligation.
Bank: [[text:Claimant's Counsel:Bank]]  Account name: [[text:Claimant's Counsel:Account name]]
[[check:Claimant's Counsel:Trust account confirmed]] Counsel confirms the account is its client trust account.

values.matter: Baybridge Logistics LLC v. Fontara, Inc.

summary: A NEW document inline with recipient authentication: the claimant proves identity with Docusign ID Verification, and counsel opens the envelope with an access code; counsel signs after the claimant.
emailBlurb: Please verify your identity and sign the payment authorization.
